name: worldlabs-mcp
description: Generate explorable 3D worlds from text, images, panoramas, multi-view sets, or video via the World Labs Marble API (marble-1.1 / marble-1.1-plus). Includes a Spark 2.0 splat viewer and a scaffolded Spatial Voice Agent.

text_to_world.description: Generate 3D worlds from text prompts (marble-1.1 / marble-1.1-plus)

multi_image_to_world.description: Generate 3D worlds from multiple images at azimuth angles

local_file_upload.description: Upload local files and generate worlds end-to-end

operation_polling.description: Poll and wait for async generation operations

world_management.description: List, retrieve, and delete worlds. Asset URLs (SPZ, GLB, panorama, thumbnail, caption)

delete_world.description: Permanently delete a world and all its assets via DELETE /marble/v1/worlds/{id}

deterministic_generation.description: seed parameter for reproducible world generation

world_tags.description: tags parameter for organising worlds on creation

disable_recaption.description: disable_recaption parameter to prevent API from auto-rewriting prompts

world_library_ui.description: Web dashboard /library page with card/list views, search, filters, thumbnails, asset downloads

prompt_presets.description: 15 high-detail Marble-optimised presets with category filtering in the Style Gallery

builtin_tts.description: Edge-TTS engine auto-generates spatial narration audio. No external service needed.

default_agent_avatar.description: Built-in generated GLB humanoid for populating scenes via spawn_agent_avatar

painting_portals.description: 14 canonical paintings as image-to-world seeds. Click to generate, then walk through.

file_upload_generation.description: Drag-and-drop local image/video files for world generation via /api/generate/upload

headset_setup_wizard.description: Step-by-step onboarding for Quest/Pico 4 with live ADB device detection

adb_device_detection.description: GET /api/adb/devices runs adb devices server-side for live headset detection

avatar_mcp_integration.description: Probe avatar-mcp on port 10793, list avatars, place them in worlds via narration SSE

resonite_import.description: Export worlds to Resonite via OSC or resonite-mcp ResoniteLink import

splat_cors_proxy.description: GET /api/handoff proxies remote SPZ/GLB files to avoid CORS issues

spark_viewer.description: In-browser Spark 2.0 viewer with .RAD LoD streaming and HRTF spatial audio

spatial_voice_agent.description: Coordinate-anchored TTS narration via the narration bridge. Requires the bridge to be running.

media_asset_inventory.description: GET /api/media-assets/{id} endpoint for querying uploaded media asset metadata

community_gallery.description: gallery_explore MCP tool + /api/gallery browse & keyword search over public marble.worldlabs.ai worlds (prompts, seeds, SPZ assets); 10 presets mined from showpieces
